item.title: Trump says UK's Starmer making 'a big mistake' on Diego Garcia lease
item.description: US President said Washington may need to use bases at Diego Garcia and RAF Fairford if tensions with Iran escalate, warning such options could be considered should Tehran decline a nuclear deal.

item.title: Türkiye condemns Israeli 'annexation' efforts in occupied West Bank during Security Council session
item.description: During high-level Security Council session, Ambassador Ahmet Yildiz called for full implementation of President Trump's 20-point peace plan.

item.title: Balcazar installed as Peru's interim president following Jeri's ouster
item.description: Lawmakers in Peru elected Jose Balcazar as interim president after ousting Jose Jeri over a scandal, extending the country’s cycle of political instability just weeks before the April general elections.

item.title: Podcaster Tucker Carlson briefly held then released by Israeli airport security: report
item.description: US embassy spokesperson denies detention, says Carlson received the same passport control questions that ‘countless visitors to Israel’ receive.

item.title: 'Playing with fire' — Russia's Lavrov warns against US strike on Iran
item.description: Russia warns that military action could spark a wider regional crisis and undermine fragile diplomatic gains, while confirming ongoing talks with Syria’s new leadership to preserve its key military presence.

item.title: Bill Gates pulls out of India AI summit amid Epstein fallout
item.description: Microsoft co-founder cancels his keynote at the AI Impact Summit in New Delhi after being named in the latest Epstein files, saying he wants the focus to remain on artificial intelligence.

item.title: AI cannot be left to 'whims of a few billionaires': UN chief
item.description: UN chief calls on tech tycoons to support a $3 billion global fund to ensure open access to the fast-advancing technology for all.

item.title: Daily News Brief | February 19th
item.description: Israel expands seizures in Palestine's occupied West Bank, testing US red lines, and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan extends Ramadan wishes to the nation and Muslim world.

item.title: French pro-Palestine group calls for boycott of dates produced in illegal Israeli settlements
item.description: The head of the France-based EuroPalestine Association says boycotting these products would negatively impact the Israeli economy.

item.title: ‘My trumpet plants’: Epstein grew plants linked to potent mind-altering drug
item.description: Scopolamine is a drug that can induce a zombie-like state in its victims and naturally occurs in plants of the Brugmansia genus, commonly known as Angel's Trumpet.
